decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The pruning works hereby approved shall be strictly limited to 5m removed from each branch, when measured from the tips of the re-growth. All growth within the internal remaining crown structure shall be left in situ, in order to provide the tree with leaf bearing structure wherewith it can continue its physiological processes after the works hereby approved are completed. The works shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
